executiveSummary: All 5 user stories and 9 functional requirements comply with the PRD. Two minor gaps (unknown-modality silent fallthrough in tasks.py; missing accessibility wrapper on the playground radio group) were resolved during the audit refactor.
minorObservations: queue.ts conditional guard: modelId/modality/architecture/components only merged when job.modelId is truthy — intentional legacy compat, left as-is.
models.py optional defaults: modality/architecture/components have empty defaults; missing fields fall to error-callback path, not HTTP 422 — left as-is.
tasks.py unknown modality: FIXED — added explicit txt2img branch and else-raise-ValueError to prevent silent fallthrough.
Playground radio group accessibility: FIXED — wrapped in fieldset/legend and added role=radiogroup + aria-label.
Playground submit-while-loading: JS guard catches empty model select and shows error — acceptable as-is.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Iteration 000006 is complete and fully compliant. Two recommendations were applied: (1) explicit modality guard in tasks.py; (2) accessibility wrapper on the playground mode toggle.

refactorPlan.change: Replace catch-all else on modality with explicit elif 'txt2img' + else raise ValueError
refactorPlan.rationale: Prevents silent misrouting of unknown modality values; triggers error callback instead.

refactorPlan.change: Wrap mode-toggle radio group in fieldset/legend; add role=radiogroup and aria-label to container div
refactorPlan.rationale: Screen readers announce the group's purpose without requiring inspection of individual radio labels.
